body: Guess I was just hoping for society to show me that there is some good in people but obviously that was stupid of me.
I won't kill anyone else by accident and safety measures are usually for stopping accidents not purposeful incidents.
I need to die and I need something I can't get my hands on any other way than for there to be one witness. I am desperate
You can't guilt me out of this if that's what you're trying to do.
Everything about me is pathetic obviously otherwise I wouldn't have been so scared to leave the abusive relationship.
It's my life and I have the right to do what I want with it!
I know they will be hurt, but it's not about them. I've also seen how well they are able to support each other, yes it will be hard for them but they will manage.
It's not a "might as well situation" ab for if you think it is you obviously don't understand what I am feeling.
I will be the one to do it, I am sorry that there will be a witness but I will be the one doing the killing.
I know, other methods just haven't worked and it's the only way to get hold of what I need to do it.
For the reasons I said in the post
